:::{#sol-orthogonal-vectors-practice}

$c = 1$.
By @def-orthogonal-vectors,
$\vx \perp \vy$ exactly when

$$
\ba
0
&= \vx \cdot \vy
&& \text{(@def-orthogonal-vectors)}
\\
&= 2 \cd 1 + c \cd 3 + 1 \cd (-5)
&& \text{(@def-dot-product)}
\\
&= 3c - 3,
&& \text{(multiply and collect terms)}
\ea
$$

which holds only for $c = 1$.

:::
